author: nerfgun2002
body:
Lets Firstly State This, I Am Very Honest With My Appeal.

First Evidence I Have: BryanHuen Has Been Banned 5 Months Ago, Why Would I? nerfgun2002, Be Using That Account. Although BryanHuen was my Alt Account, I didn't use it to get it banned on here. I lent my Account And My Wifi To My Neighbour Because He Wanted To Play Minecraft, but I didn't expect him to get himself banned on here. I know its my fault to lend him my account, but think of it, I didn't allow him to use my Main Account: nerfgun2002 because this is my important account and I cannot let anyone meddle with it.
First Link: avicus.net/BryanHuen

So Now, sloby_globs. This is not my account and I have nothing to do with it. Look at this avicus.net/sloby_globs
Banned 4 Months Ago, Why Would I Be Using It. For Your Info This Is My Neighbour's Account That Was Lent By His ClassMate. I totally have nothing to do with it!

You May Think This Appeal Is Totally A Lie, But Its Not. Please Also Give Me The Picture Of The IP Address Checked.
-nerfgun2002
